text:
deploybot: tag created: v2.5.1 (sha: a1b2c3d). Environments: prod, staging. Canary: us-east-1 10% for 15m. Changelog highlights: fast-kv caching, runtime kernel fixes, small API contract tweak to /v1/generate. Release notes: https://git.redwood.ai/releases/v2.5.1 · CI: green · migration: none. Pin recommended for customers on Dedicated.

ops-kate: thanks! can we pin the tag in console and add a short blurb to product channel? :thumbsup:

celeste: quick Q — which services need rolling restarts? runtime and gateway only?

raj: runtime, gateway, and router. rolling restart plan: router -> gateway -> runtime, 5% batch, 30s drain. rollback plan: fallback tag v2.5.0, kill canary, route traffic back. rollback command: `./infra/release rollback --tag v2.5.1 --env prod`

ana: heads-up: model-migration flag is toggled on in staging for tests, but prod flag is still off. I'll keep an eye on evals during canary window.

luca: EU customers often ask for pins — request we notify europe-sales and pin for eu region if metrics look good after 30m.

deploybot: pinned builds created for Dedicated customers (IDs: C-112, C-114) per request. Console pin link: https://console.redwood.ai/releases/v2.5.1/pins. Canary started at 2249990020. Monitoring endpoints: https://observability.redwood.ai/dashboards/release-v2.5.1 (latency, error-rate, cost-per-token).

ops-kate: added a modal note for PMs and put a short blurb in #product: "v2.5.1: perf + runtime fixes, rolling canary now"

celeste: any special rollback conditions? e.g., error-rate > 3% or latency p99 +200ms for 5m?

raj: yes — trigger if 1) error-rate >= 3% sustained for 5m, 2) p99 increase > 150ms sustained 5m, or 3) model quality regressions flagged by evals. If triggered, escalate to @oncall-sre and execute rollback command above.

ana: canary evals look green so far (first 5m). tagging note: git command used: `git tag -a v2.5.1 a1b2c3d -m "release: v2.5.1 - runtime/caching fixes"` then pushed to origin.

luca: EU pin request filed (ticket #INC-4891). Will wait for 30m signal before promoting.

ops-kate: thanks team — i'll hold off on mass comms until 30m check. :eyes: anyone want to be the 30m watcher?

celeste: i'll take 15-30m window and post results here.

raj: standing by for rollback if needed.

deploybot: canary complete at 2249990045 — 0.14% error-rate, p99 +12ms, traffic promoted to 100% in prod. Release tag v2.5.1 is now live across regions. Notes appended to release page. :tada:
